decisions_made.decision: Referral MVP: 1-level only (A→B). Multi-level (A→B→C) is Phase 2.
decisions_made.reason: Keep complexity low for MVP. Multi-level adds fraud surface area.

decisions_made.decision: Fraud prevention: Admin manual review only in MVP.
decisions_made.reason: OTP phone verification deferred. Too much scope for now.

decisions_made.decision: 5 Tier names: Đồng → Bạc → Vàng → Bạch Kim → Kim Cương
decisions_made.reason: Fits BĐS (Gold/Platinum/Diamond branding) + familiar to Vietnamese users.

decisions_made.decision: Reward redemption: Admin-manual fulfillment in MVP (no automated voucher system)
decisions_made.reason: Automated voucher inventory is complex. Triage via adminNote field.

decisions_made.decision: Decoupled Dev DB from Supabase using Docker
decisions_made.reason: Prevent accidental production data mutation during development.
